content_html:
Claude Code Beam

Teleport a Claude Code session between your devices. Same conversation, same context, across different machines.

Teleport to a different environment (remote desktop, cloud, etc.) with /ccbeam:up.

The conversation picks up over there with its context intact — same session id, nothing summarised — and your uncommitted changes travel with it. From then on everything runs on that machine: its CPU, its CLAUDE.md, its hooks, its MCP servers. /ccbeam:home brings you back, with whatever you changed.

  • Any machine in your ~/.ssh/config is a destination. If you can ssh there, it's already in the list. Nothing to install on it beyond Claude Code, and no daemon to leave running.
  • Or a cloud sandbox, on your own key. Bring an E2B API key and cloud joins the same list. ccbeam runs no infrastructure, holds no keys and proxies nothing — there is no hosted ccbeam to sign up for.
  • No account, no daemon, no config file. It uses the SSH you already have.

Install

npm i -g ccbeam
ccbeam install-shell   # optional: keep typing `claude`

ccbeam takes the same options as claude and hands the terminal straight to the real Claude Code. It's a supervisor, not a replacement.

ccbeam                # like `claude`
ccbeam --model opus   # any claude flag works

install-shell adds one delimited block to your .bashrc, .zshrc or config.fish so the command you type stays claude:

claude() { command ccbeam "$@"; }

Same trick nvm, pyenv and direnv use. command claude still runs Claude Code directly, and ccbeam uninstall-shell restores the file exactly as it was (it's backed up before the first edit either way).

Beam

Inside a session:
/ccbeam:up pick a device, then a folder
/ccbeam:up gpu-box pick a folder on gpu-box
/ccbeam:up gpu-box:~/trainer go straight there
/ccbeam:up cloud go to your cloud box
/ccbeam:home return to where this session started

/ccbeam:home works from wherever you are, however many hops in — and /ccbeam:up home is the same thing if that's what your fingers reach for.

local is a device like any other, so /ccbeam:up also moves a conversation between folders on the machine you're already on, which Claude Code can't otherwise do mid-session.

From a shell:
ccbeam devices list devices and what they're doing
ccbeam doctor gpu-box check a device is ready
ccbeam cloud set up the cloud box
ccbeam install-shell / uninstall-shell shell integration

The picker

  beam to
  ⌂ local              you are here
    gpu-box            2h ago
    mac-mini           yesterday
  ☁ cloud              paused
  ↑↓ select · ⏎ confirm · type to filter · esc cancel

The list is read from your ~/.ssh/config, so there's no registry to keep in sync and nothing to run on a machine to "add" it. cloud is always there, set up or not.

  gpu-box — folder
  ~/dev/api                     main ·3 dirty
  ~/src/trainer                 cuda-12
  ~/dev/scratch                 main

Folders come from that device's own Claude Code history: every directory you've actually worked in, newest first, with branch and dirty-file count so you can see what you're walking into. The one you used last is pre-selected, so going back somewhere is /ccbeam:up → ⏎ → ⏎.

What travels

  • The conversation. The transcript is copied to the destination and resumed there under the same session id, so the context is genuinely intact rather than summarised.
  • Your uncommitted work, if the folder is a git repo — modified and untracked files both. It comes back when you do.
  • Nothing else. Settings, MCP servers, hooks and credentials belong to the device you're on. That's the point: you get that machine's environment.

Uncommitted changes are the easiest thing in the world to lose, so every carry either verifies its assumptions or refuses:

  • The destination must be on the same commit. A patch applied to a different base is how work silently disappears.
  • The destination must be clean, unless it's the tree you left.
  • Coming home, the folder you left must be unchanged. If something edited it while you were away, ccbeam refuses and saves the incoming work to ~/.ccbeam/incoming-<timestamp>/ rather than overwriting anything.

The cloud box

/ccbeam:up cloud is a sandbox that behaves like any other device. The first time, it asks for an E2B key and sets itself up; after that it's two lines on screen and about a second.

› /ccbeam:up cloud

  · waking the cloud box
  · carried 3 changed file(s)

 ☁ cloud:~/dev/api  ·  /ccbeam:home to return

It runs on your account. ccbeam operates no infrastructure, holds no keys and proxies nothing — your code goes from your machine to your sandbox, with nothing in between. There is no hosted ccbeam and there is not going to be one.

A few decisions worth knowing about:

  • It's one box, and it persists. Pausing preserves the filesystem and memory indefinitely, and resuming takes about a second. So the box stays signed in and keeps whatever you installed on it — a machine you happen to rent by the second, not a fresh container each time.
  • It pauses the moment you leave, and says so. It also can't run away from you: every sandbox is created with a finite timeout and autoPause, so even if ccbeam is killed outright the box puts itself to sleep instead of billing you until you notice.
  • A fresh box is seeded from your laptop, not from GitHub. ccbeam ships a git bundle of your history so the box lands on the exact commit your uncommitted work was written against. It works on repos you've never pushed and branches that only exist locally, and the box never needs a credential for your git host.
  • The E2B SDK is not a dependency. It's fetched into ~/.ccbeam/deps at a pinned version the first time you set the cloud box up. Installing ccbeam pulls nothing for a feature you haven't used.

Leaving a conversation there, and picking it up again

Because the box persists, a conversation you took there stays there. Close the laptop and come back to it:

/ccbeam:up cloud resume      pick up a conversation living on the box

ccbeam cloud sessions        list them
ccbeam cloud resume          pick one up, starting a session here
ccbeam cloud rm <id>         delete one

resume is a separate verb on purpose. /ccbeam:up cloud means this conversation moves there, keeping its session id — which is the whole reason its context survives. /ccbeam:up cloud resume adopts a different conversation and leaves the one you're in exactly where it was. If those shared a verb, /ccbeam:up could silently abandon your place; they don't, so it can't.

The session picker shows what you first said, the folder, when it was last touched, and marks any conversation still running. Ctrl-D deletes the highlighted one, keeping the folder it worked in — ccbeam doesn't delete your files. Conversations untouched for 30 days are pruned when the box wakes, and it says so when that happens.

Work genuinely continues in the box after you disconnect, and a paused box freezes a turn mid-flight and resumes it intact. ccbeam doesn't reattach to the old terminal, though — it doesn't need to. The transcript is the session, so picking one back up is claude --resume over there, which is what every beam already does.

ccbeam cloud destroy gets rid of the box. ccbeam cloud repair builds a new one.

Requirements

A device you beam to needs ssh access, Claude Code (signed in), node 18+ and git. ccbeam doctor <device> tells you what's missing. The cloud box installs its own — but driving it needs Node 20.18.1+ (not 21.x) on the machine you beam from, because the E2B SDK runs there. ssh devices are fine on 18.

$ ccbeam devices
  ● local                you are here
  ● gpu-box              2h ago
  ○ mac-mini             yesterday
  ⏸ cloud                paused

Each device signs in to Claude Code itself, with claude auth login. That's deliberate — see below.

What ccbeam won't do

  • Forward credentials, ever. ccbeam will never proxy model calls through your laptop or ship your token to another device. Anthropic's terms prohibit using Claude subscription OAuth tokens in other products or services; each device authenticating itself is the only correct design, not a limitation to engineer around. The cloud box is no exception: it signs itself in, in its own terminal, and that sign-in survives because a paused sandbox keeps its filesystem.
  • Run a hosted anything. Not a relay, not a proxy, not a default API key, not even a sandbox image published under a maintainer's account. Nothing in the runtime path depends on infrastructure you don't control.
  • Sandbox your ssh devices. Claude Code runs on the far machine as you, with your access — the same as if you'd ssh'd in and started it yourself. The cloud box is isolated, which is a reason to use it, but that's a property of E2B rather than of ccbeam.
  • Team access control. It's your devices and your keys.

How it works

  1. ccbeam launches the real claude with a small bundled plugin, and waits.
  2. /ccbeam:up calls a tool that writes a request file. A slash command can't take over the terminal, so it doesn't try.
  3. The plugin's Stop hook ends the session at the turn boundary — after the transcript is completely written.
  4. The supervisor, which has owned the terminal all along, ships the transcript and your changes to the destination and launches the real claude there, attached to your terminal.

There's no protocol to speak and no daemon on the far side; ssh connection sharing keeps the repeated calls at ~10ms each.

docs/design.md covers why the supervisor has to exist, and how to add a device kind — Fly Machines, Modal, Daytona and plain VMs are all a fifty-line SshDevice plus a lifecycle, which is the intended shape of a contribution.

Development

npm test          # unit tests — no network, no accounts
npm run test:e2e  # end-to-end, needs a reachable host in CCBEAM_HOST

The unit suite drives the real seeding and carrying logic through a fake device that shells out locally, so bundle → clone → patch is exercised without a host. Setup for the e2e suite is in docs/design.md; TESTING.md is the manual brief for the paths a machine can't check by itself.

blocks.html_en: The list is read from your ~/.ssh/config, so there's no registry to keep in sync and nothing to run on a machine to "add" it. cloud is always there, set up or not.

sentences.en: The list is read from your ~/.ssh/config, so there's no registry to keep in sync and nothing to run on a machine to "add" it.
sentences.zh: 该列表是从您的 ~/.ssh/config 中读取的，因此没有注册表可以保持同步，也不需要在计算机上运行任何内容来“添加”它。

sentences.en: cloud is always there, set up or not.
sentences.zh: 无论是否设置，云始终存在。

blocks.html_en: Folders come from that device's own Claude Code history: every directory you've actually worked in, newest first, with branch and dirty-file count so you can see what you're walking into. The one you used last is pre-selected, so going back somewhere is /ccbeam:up → ⏎ → ⏎.

sentences.en: Folders come from that device's own Claude Code history: every directory you've actually worked in, newest first, with branch and dirty-file count so you can see what you're walking into.
sentences.zh: 文件夹来自该设备自己的克劳德代码历史记录：您实际工作过的每个目录，最新的在前，带有分支和脏文件计数，以便您可以看到您正在进入的内容。

sentences.en: The one you used last is pre-selected, so going back somewhere is /ccbeam:up → ⏎ → ⏎.
sentences.zh: 您最后使用的那个是预先选择的，因此返回某个位置是 /ccbeam:up → ⏎ → ⏎。

blocks.html_en: What travels

sentences.en: What travels
sentences.zh: 旅行什么

blocks.html_en: • The conversation. The transcript is copied to the destination and resumed there under the same session id, so the context is genuinely intact rather than summarised.

sentences.en: The conversation.
sentences.zh: 谈话。

sentences.en: The transcript is copied to the destination and resumed there under the same session id, so the context is genuinely intact rather than summarised.
sentences.zh: 脚本被复制到目的地并在相同的会话 ID 下恢复，因此上下文是真正完整的，而不是摘要的。

blocks.html_en: • Your uncommitted work, if the folder is a git repo — modified and untracked files both. It comes back when you do.

sentences.en: Your uncommitted work, if the folder is a git repo — modified and untracked files both.
sentences.zh: 如果该文件夹是 git 存储库，则您未提交的工作 — 已修改和未跟踪的文件。

sentences.en: It comes back when you do.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做时它就会回来。

blocks.html_en: • Nothing else. Settings, MCP servers, hooks and credentials belong to the device you're on. That's the point: you get that machine's environment.

sentences.en: Nothing else.
sentences.zh: 没有别的了。

sentences.en: Settings, MCP servers, hooks and credentials belong to the device you're on.
sentences.zh: 设置、MCP 服务器、挂钩和凭据都属于您所在的设备。

sentences.en: That's the point: you get that machine's environment.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点：您获得了该机器的环境。

blocks.html_en: Uncommitted changes are the easiest thing in the world to lose, so every carry either verifies its assumptions or refuses:

sentences.en: Uncommitted changes are the easiest thing in the world to lose, so every carry either verifies its assumptions or refuses:
sentences.zh: 未提交的更改是世界上最容易丢失的东西，因此每个进位要么验证其假设，要么拒绝：

blocks.html_en: • The destination must be on the same commit. A patch applied to a different base is how work silently disappears.

sentences.en: The destination must be on the same commit.
sentences.zh: 目的地必须位于同一提交上。

sentences.en: A patch applied to a different base is how work silently disappears.
sentences.zh: 将补丁应用到不同的基础上，工作就会悄然消失。

blocks.html_en: • The destination must be clean, unless it's the tree you left.

sentences.en: The destination must be clean, unless it's the tree you left.
sentences.zh: 目的地必须是干净的，除非是你离开的那棵树。

blocks.html_en: • Coming home, the folder you left must be unchanged. If something edited it while you were away, ccbeam refuses and saves the incoming work to ~/.ccbeam/incoming-<timestamp>/ rather than overwriting anything.

sentences.en: Coming home, the folder you left must be unchanged.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，您留下的文件夹必须保持不变。

sentences.en: If something edited it while you were away, ccbeam refuses and saves the incoming work to ~/.ccbeam/incoming-<timestamp>/ rather than overwriting anything.
sentences.zh: 如果您在离开时对其进行了编辑，ccbeam 会拒绝并将传入的工作保存到 ~/.ccbeam/incoming-<timestamp>/ 而不是覆盖任何内容。

blocks.html_en: The cloud box

sentences.en: The cloud box
sentences.zh: 云盒子

blocks.html_en: /ccbeam:up cloud is a sandbox that behaves like any other device. The first time, it asks for an E2B key and sets itself up; after that it's two lines on screen and about a second.

sentences.en: /ccbeam:up cloud is a sandbox that behaves like any other device.
sentences.zh: /ccbeam:up cloud 是一个沙箱，其行为与任何其他设备类似。

sentences.en: The first time, it asks for an E2B key and sets itself up; after that it's two lines on screen and about a second.
sentences.zh: 第一次，它会请求 E2B 密钥并自行设置；之后屏幕上出现两行，大约一秒钟。

blocks.html_en: It runs on your account. ccbeam operates no infrastructure, holds no keys and proxies nothing — your code goes from your machine to your sandbox, with nothing in between. There is no hosted ccbeam and there is not going to be one.

sentences.en: It runs on your account.
sentences.zh: 它在您的帐户上运行。

sentences.en: ccbeam operates no infrastructure, holds no keys and proxies nothing — your code goes from your machine to your sandbox, with nothing in between.
sentences.zh: ccbeam 不运行任何基础设施，不持有任何密钥，也不代理任何内容——您的代码从您的机器传输到您的沙箱，中间没有任何中间过程。

sentences.en: There is no hosted ccbeam and there is not going to be one.
sentences.zh: 没有托管的 ccbeam，也不会有。

blocks.html_en: A few decisions worth knowing about:

sentences.en: A few decisions worth knowing about:
sentences.zh: 一些值得了解的决定：

blocks.html_en: • It's one box, and it persists. Pausing preserves the filesystem and memory indefinitely, and resuming takes about a second. So the box stays signed in and keeps whatever you installed on it — a machine you happen to rent by the second, not a fresh container each time.

sentences.en: It's one box, and it persists.
sentences.zh: 它只是一个盒子，而且一直存在。

sentences.en: Pausing preserves the filesystem and memory indefinitely, and resuming takes about a second.
sentences.zh: 暂停会无限期地保留文件系统和内存，恢复大约需要一秒钟。

sentences.en: So the box stays signed in and keeps whatever you installed on it — a machine you happen to rent by the second, not a fresh container each time.
sentences.zh: 因此，该盒子保持登录状态，并保留您在其上安装的所有内容 - 一台您恰好租用的机器，而不是每次都使用新的容器。

blocks.html_en: • It pauses the moment you leave, and says so. It also can't run away from you: every sandbox is created with a finite timeout and autoPause, so even if ccbeam is killed outright the box puts itself to sleep instead of billing you until you notice.

sentences.en: It pauses the moment you leave, and says so.
sentences.zh: 你离开的那一刻它就停了下来，并这样说。

sentences.en: It also can't run away from you: every sandbox is created with a finite timeout and autoPause, so even if ccbeam is killed outright the box puts itself to sleep instead of billing you until you notice.
sentences.zh: 它也无法逃离你：每个沙箱都是通过有限的超时和自动暂停创建的，因此即使 ccbeam 被直接杀死，沙箱也会自行进入睡眠状态，而不是向你收费，直到你注意到为止。

blocks.html_en: • A fresh box is seeded from your laptop, not from GitHub. ccbeam ships a git bundle of your history so the box lands on the exact commit your uncommitted work was written against. It works on repos you've never pushed and branches that only exist locally, and the box never needs a credential for your git host.

sentences.en: A fresh box is seeded from your laptop, not from GitHub.
sentences.zh: 一个新的盒子是从你的笔记本电脑而不是 GitHub 上播种的。

sentences.en: ccbeam ships a git bundle of your history so the box lands on the exact commit your uncommitted work was written against.
sentences.zh: ccbeam 会发送您的历史记录的 git 包，以便该盒子准确地落在您未提交的工作所针对的提交上。

sentences.en: It works on repos you've never pushed and branches that only exist locally, and the box never needs a credential for your git host.
sentences.zh: 它适用于您从未推送过的存储库和仅存在于本地的分支，并且该盒子永远不需要您的 git 主机的凭据。

blocks.html_en: • The E2B SDK is not a dependency. It's fetched into ~/.ccbeam/deps at a pinned version the first time you set the cloud box up. Installing ccbeam pulls nothing for a feature you haven't used.

sentences.en: The E2B SDK is not a dependency.
sentences.zh: E2B SDK 不是依赖项。

sentences.en: It's fetched into ~/.ccbeam/deps at a pinned version the first time you set the cloud box up.
sentences.zh: 第一次设置云盒时，它会以固定版本的形式提取到 ~/.ccbeam/deps 中。

sentences.en: Installing ccbeam pulls nothing for a feature you haven't used.
sentences.zh: 安装 ccbeam 不会为您未使用过的功能带来任何帮助。

blocks.html_en: Leaving a conversation there, and picking it up again

sentences.en: Leaving a conversation there, and picking it up again
sentences.zh: 将对话留在那里，然后再次拾起

blocks.html_en: Because the box persists, a conversation you took there stays there. Close the laptop and come back to it:

sentences.en: Because the box persists, a conversation you took there stays there.
sentences.zh: 由于该框仍然存在，因此您在其中进行的对话也会保留在那里。

sentences.en: Close the laptop and come back to it:
sentences.zh: 关闭笔记本电脑并返回：

blocks.html_en: resume is a separate verb on purpose. /ccbeam:up cloud means this conversation moves there, keeping its session id — which is the whole reason its context survives. /ccbeam:up cloud resume adopts a different conversation and leaves the one you're in exactly where it was. If those shared a verb, /ccbeam:up could silently abandon your place; they don't, so it can't.

sentences.en: resume is a separate verb on purpose. /ccbeam:up cloud means this conversation moves there, keeping its session id — which is the whole reason its context survives. /ccbeam:up cloud resume adopts a different conversation and leaves the one you're in exactly where it was.
sentences.zh: 简历是故意的一个单独的动词。 /ccbeam:up cloud 意味着此对话移至那里，并保留其会话 ID — 这就是其上下文得以幸存的全部原因。 /ccbeam:up 云简历采用不同的对话，并将您所在的对话保留在原来的位置。

sentences.en: If those shared a verb, /ccbeam:up could silently abandon your place; they don't, so it can't.
sentences.zh: 如果他们共用一个动词，/ccbeam:up 可能会默默地放弃你的位置；他们不这样做，所以它不能。

blocks.html_en: The session picker shows what you first said, the folder, when it was last touched, and marks any conversation still running. Ctrl-D deletes the highlighted one, keeping the folder it worked in — ccbeam doesn't delete your files. Conversations untouched for 30 days are pruned when the box wakes, and it says so when that happens.

sentences.en: The session picker shows what you first said, the folder, when it was last touched, and marks any conversation still running.
sentences.zh: 会话选择器显示您第一次所说的内容、最后一次触摸文件夹的时间，并标记仍在运行的任何对话。

sentences.en: Ctrl-D deletes the highlighted one, keeping the folder it worked in — ccbeam doesn't delete your files.
sentences.zh: Ctrl-D 删除突出显示的文件，保留它所在的文件夹 - ccbeam 不会删除您的文件。

sentences.en: Conversations untouched for 30 days are pruned when the box wakes, and it says so when that happens.
sentences.zh: 当盒子被唤醒时，30 天未受影响的对话将被删除，并且当这种情况发生时它会这样说。

blocks.html_en: Work genuinely continues in the box after you disconnect, and a paused box freezes a turn mid-flight and resumes it intact. ccbeam doesn't reattach to the old terminal, though — it doesn't need to. The transcript is the session, so picking one back up is claude --resume over there, which is what every beam already does.

sentences.en: Work genuinely continues in the box after you disconnect, and a paused box freezes a turn mid-flight and resumes it intact.
sentences.zh: 断开连接后，盒子中的工作真正会继续，暂停的盒子会在飞行中冻结转弯并完整恢复。

sentences.en: ccbeam doesn't reattach to the old terminal, though — it doesn't need to.
sentences.zh: 不过，ccbeam 不会重新连接到旧终端 - 它不需要这样做。

sentences.en: The transcript is the session, so picking one back up is claude --resume over there, which is what every beam already does.
sentences.zh: 成绩单就是会议，所以选择一个备份就是那边的 claude --resume，这就是每个光束已经做的事情。

blocks.html_en: ccbeam cloud destroy gets rid of the box. ccbeam cloud repair builds a new one.

sentences.en: ccbeam cloud destroy gets rid of the box.
sentences.zh: ccbeam cloud destroy 摆脱了盒子。

sentences.en: ccbeam cloud repair builds a new one.
sentences.zh: ccbeam云修复构建了一个新的。

blocks.html_en: Requirements

sentences.en: Requirements
sentences.zh: 要求

blocks.html_en: A device you beam to needs ssh access, Claude Code (signed in), node 18+ and git. ccbeam doctor <device> tells you what's missing. The cloud box installs its own — but driving it needs Node 20.18.1+ (not 21.x) on the machine you beam from, because the E2B SDK runs there. ssh devices are fine on 18.

sentences.en: A device you beam to needs ssh access, Claude Code (signed in), node 18+ and git.
sentences.zh: 您发送到的设备需要 ssh 访问权限、Claude Code（已登录）、节点 18+ 和 git。

sentences.en: ccbeam doctor <device> tells you what's missing.
sentences.zh: ccbeam doctor <device> 告诉您缺少什么。

sentences.en: The cloud box installs its own — but driving it needs Node 20.18.1+ (not 21.x) on the machine you beam from, because the E2B SDK runs there.
sentences.zh: 云盒会安装自己的云盒，但驱动它需要在您发送数据的机器上安装 Node 20.18.1+（而不是 21.x），因为 E2B SDK 在那里运行。

sentences.en: ssh devices are fine on 18.
sentences.zh: ssh 设备在 18 上运行良好。

blocks.html_en: Each device signs in to Claude Code itself, with claude auth login. That's deliberate — see below.

sentences.en: Each device signs in to Claude Code itself, with claude auth login.
sentences.zh: 每个设备都使用 claude auth login 登录 Claude Code 本身。

sentences.en: That's deliberate — see below.
sentences.zh: 这是故意的——见下文。

blocks.html_en: What ccbeam won't do

sentences.en: What ccbeam won't do
sentences.zh: ccbeam 不会做什么

blocks.html_en: • Forward credentials, ever. ccbeam will never proxy model calls through your laptop or ship your token to another device. Anthropic's terms prohibit using Claude subscription OAuth tokens in other products or services; each device authenticating itself is the only correct design, not a limitation to engineer around. The cloud box is no exception: it signs itself in, in its own terminal, and that sign-in survives because a paused sandbox keeps its filesystem.

sentences.en: Forward credentials, ever.
sentences.zh: 永远转发凭证。

sentences.en: ccbeam will never proxy model calls through your laptop or ship your token to another device.
sentences.zh: ccbeam 永远不会通过您的笔记本电脑代理模型调用或将您的令牌发送到其他设备。

sentences.en: Anthropic's terms prohibit using Claude subscription OAuth tokens in other products or services; each device authenticating itself is the only correct design, not a limitation to engineer around.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 的条款禁止在其他产品或服务中使用 Claude 订阅 OAuth 令牌；每个设备自我验证是唯一正确的设计，而不是工程师周围的限制。

sentences.en: The cloud box is no exception: it signs itself in, in its own terminal, and that sign-in survives because a paused sandbox keeps its filesystem.
sentences.zh: 云盒也不例外：它在自己的终端中自行登录，并且该登录仍然存在，因为暂停的沙箱保留了其文件系统。

blocks.html_en: • Run a hosted anything. Not a relay, not a proxy, not a default API key, not even a sandbox image published under a maintainer's account. Nothing in the runtime path depends on infrastructure you don't control.

sentences.en: Run a hosted anything.
sentences.zh: 运行托管的任何东西。

sentences.en: Not a relay, not a proxy, not a default API key, not even a sandbox image published under a maintainer's account.
sentences.zh: 不是中继，不是代理，不是默认 API 密钥，甚至不是在维护者帐户下发布的沙箱映像。

sentences.en: Nothing in the runtime path depends on infrastructure you don't control.
sentences.zh: 运行时路径中的任何内容都不依赖于您无法控制的基础设施。

blocks.html_en: • Sandbox your ssh devices. Claude Code runs on the far machine as you, with your access — the same as if you'd ssh'd in and started it yourself. The cloud box is isolated, which is a reason to use it, but that's a property of E2B rather than of ccbeam.

sentences.en: Sandbox your ssh devices.
sentences.zh: 将您的 ssh 设备沙箱化。

sentences.en: Claude Code runs on the far machine as you, with your access — the same as if you'd ssh'd in and started it yourself.
sentences.zh: Claude Code 与您一样在远端计算机上运行，​​并具有您的访问权限 — 就像您通过 ssh 登录并自己启动它一样。

sentences.en: The cloud box is isolated, which is a reason to use it, but that's a property of E2B rather than of ccbeam.
sentences.zh: 云盒是隔离的，这是使用它的一个原因，但这是 E2B 的属性，而不是 ccbeam 的属性。

blocks.html_en: • Team access control. It's your devices and your keys.

sentences.en: Team access control.
sentences.zh: 团队访问控制。

sentences.en: It's your devices and your keys.
sentences.zh: 这是您的设备和密钥。

blocks.html_en: How it works

sentences.en: How it works
sentences.zh: 它是如何运作的

blocks.html_en: • ccbeam launches the real claude with a small bundled plugin, and waits.

sentences.en: ccbeam launches the real claude with a small bundled plugin, and waits.
sentences.zh: ccbeam 使用一个小的捆绑插件启动了真正的 claude，然后等待。

blocks.html_en: • /ccbeam:up calls a tool that writes a request file. A slash command can't take over the terminal, so it doesn't try.

sentences.en: /ccbeam:up calls a tool that writes a request file.
sentences.zh: /ccbeam:up 调用写入请求文件的工具。

sentences.en: A slash command can't take over the terminal, so it doesn't try.
sentences.zh: 斜杠命令无法接管终端，因此它不会尝试。

blocks.html_en: • The plugin's Stop hook ends the session at the turn boundary — after the transcript is completely written.

sentences.en: The plugin's Stop hook ends the session at the turn boundary — after the transcript is completely written.
sentences.zh: 该插件的 Stop 钩子在回合边界处结束会话——在脚本完全写入之后。

blocks.html_en: • The supervisor, which has owned the terminal all along, ships the transcript and your changes to the destination and launches the real claude there, attached to your terminal.

sentences.en: The supervisor, which has owned the terminal all along, ships the transcript and your changes to the destination and launches the real claude there, attached to your terminal.
sentences.zh: 一直拥有该终端的主管将记录和您的更改发送到目的地，并在那里启动附加到您的终端的真实克劳德。

blocks.html_en: There's no protocol to speak and no daemon on the far side; ssh connection sharing keeps the repeated calls at ~10ms each.

sentences.en: There's no protocol to speak and no daemon on the far side; ssh connection sharing keeps the repeated calls at ~10ms each.
sentences.zh: 远端没有任何协议可言，也没有守护进程； ssh 连接共享使每次重复调用保持在约 10 毫秒。

blocks.html_en: docs/design.md covers why the supervisor has to exist, and how to add a device kind — Fly Machines, Modal, Daytona and plain VMs are all a fifty-line SshDevice plus a lifecycle, which is the intended shape of a contribution.

sentences.en: docs/design.md covers why the supervisor has to exist, and how to add a device kind — Fly Machines, Modal, Daytona and plain VMs are all a fifty-line SshDevice plus a lifecycle, which is the intended shape of a contribution.
sentences.zh: docs/design.md 介绍了管理程序为何必须存在，以及如何添加设备类型 — Fly Machines、Modal、Daytona 和普通 VM 都是 50 行 SshDevice 加上生命周期，这是贡献的预期形式。

content_html_zh:
克劳德码束

在您的设备之间传送 Claude Code 会话。 相同的对话，相同的上下文，跨不同的机器。

使用 /ccbeam:up 传送到不同的环境（远程桌面、云等）。

对话在其上下文完好无损的情况下继续进行——相同的会话 ID，没有任何总结——并且您未提交的更改也随之发生。 从那时起，一切都在该机器上运行：它的 CPU、它的 CLAUDE.md、它的钩子、它的 MCP 服务器。 /ccbeam:home 将你带回来，无论你做了什么改变。

  • ~/.ssh/config 中的任何机器都是目标。 如果您可以在那里进行 ssh，则它已经在列表中了。 除了 Claude Code 之外，无需在其上安装任何东西，也无需运行守护程序。
  • 或者使用您自己的密钥的云沙箱。 携带 E2B API 密钥，云就会加入同一列表。 ccbeam 不运行任何基础设施，不持有密钥，也不代理任何内容 — 没有托管的 ccbeam 可供注册。
  • 没有帐户，没有守护程序，没有配置文件。 它使用您已有的 SSH。

安装

npm i -g ccbeam
ccbeam install-shell   # optional: keep typing `claude`

ccbeam 采用与 claude 相同的选项，并将终端直接交给真正的 Claude 代码。 这是一个主管，而不是替代者。

ccbeam                # like `claude`
ccbeam --model opus   # any claude flag works

install-shell 会向您的 .bashrc、.zshrc 或 config.fish 添加一个分隔块，以便您输入的命令保持 claude 状态：

claude() { command ccbeam "$@"; }

nvm、pyenv 和 direnv 使用相同的技巧。 命令 claude 仍然直接运行 Claude Code，并且 ccbeam uninstall-shell 会完全按原样恢复文件（无论哪种方式，它都会在第一次编辑之前备份）。

Beam

在会话中：
/ccbeam:向上 选择一个设备，然后选择一个文件夹
/ccbeam:up GPU 盒 在 gpu-box 上选择一个文件夹
/ccbeam:up GPU-box:~/trainer 直走那里
/ccbeam:上云 前往您的云盒子
/ccbeam:主页 返回到本次会话开始的位置

无论您身在何处，/ccbeam:home 都可以工作，无论跳多少次，而 /ccbeam:up home 都是一样的，如果您的手指伸手可及的话。

local 是一个与其他设备一样的设备，因此 /ccbeam:up 还会在您已使用的计算机上的文件夹之间移动对话，而 Claude Code 无法在会话中进行此操作。

从外壳：
ccbeam 设备 列出设备及其正在执行的操作
ccbeam 医生 GPU 盒 检查设备是否准备就绪
ccbeam云 设置云盒
ccbeam 安装 shell / 卸载 shell 外壳集成

拾取器

  beam to
  ⌂ local              you are here
    gpu-box            2h ago
    mac-mini           yesterday
  ☁ cloud              paused
  ↑↓ select · ⏎ confirm · type to filter · esc cancel

该列表是从您的 ~/.ssh/config 中读取的，因此没有注册表可以保持同步，也不需要在计算机上运行任何内容来“添加”它。 无论是否设置，云始终存在。

  gpu-box — folder
  ~/dev/api                     main ·3 dirty
  ~/src/trainer                 cuda-12
  ~/dev/scratch                 main

文件夹来自该设备自己的克劳德代码历史记录：您实际工作过的每个目录，最新的在前，带有分支和脏文件计数，以便您可以看到您正在进入的内容。 您最后使用的那个是预先选择的，因此返回某个位置是 /ccbeam:up → ⏎ → ⏎。

旅行什么

  • 谈话。 脚本被复制到目的地并在相同的会话 ID 下恢复，因此上下文是真正完整的，而不是摘要的。
  • 如果该文件夹是 git 存储库，则您未提交的工作 — 已修改和未跟踪的文件。 当你这样做时它就会回来。
  • 没有别的了。 设置、MCP 服务器、挂钩和凭据都属于您所在的设备。 这就是重点：您获得了该机器的环境。

未提交的更改是世界上最容易丢失的东西，因此每个进位要么验证其假设，要么拒绝：

  • 目的地必须位于同一提交上。 将补丁应用到不同的基础上，工作就会悄然消失。
  • 目的地必须是干净的，除非是你离开的那棵树。
  • 回到家后，您留下的文件夹必须保持不变。 如果您在离开时对其进行了编辑，ccbeam 会拒绝并将传入的工作保存到 ~/.ccbeam/incoming-<timestamp>/ 而不是覆盖任何内容。

云盒子

/ccbeam:up cloud 是一个沙箱，其行为与任何其他设备类似。 第一次，它会请求 E2B 密钥并自行设置；之后屏幕上出现两行，大约一秒钟。

› /ccbeam:up cloud

  · waking the cloud box
  · carried 3 changed file(s)

 ☁ cloud:~/dev/api  ·  /ccbeam:home to return

它在您的帐户上运行。 ccbeam 不运行任何基础设施，不持有任何密钥，也不代理任何内容——您的代码从您的机器传输到您的沙箱，中间没有任何中间过程。 没有托管的 ccbeam，也不会有。

一些值得了解的决定：

  • 它只是一个盒子，而且一直存在。 暂停会无限期地保留文件系统和内存，恢复大约需要一秒钟。 因此，该盒子保持登录状态，并保留您在其上安装的所有内容 - 一台您恰好租用的机器，而不是每次都使用新的容器。
  • 你离开的那一刻它就停了下来，并这样说。 它也无法逃离你：每个沙箱都是通过有限的超时和自动暂停创建的，因此即使 ccbeam 被直接杀死，沙箱也会自行进入睡眠状态，而不是向你收费，直到你注意到为止。
  • 一个新的盒子是从你的笔记本电脑而不是 GitHub 上播种的。 ccbeam 会发送您的历史记录的 git 包，以便该盒子准确地落在您未提交的工作所针对的提交上。 它适用于您从未推送过的存储库和仅存在于本地的分支，并且该盒子永远不需要您的 git 主机的凭据。
  • E2B SDK 不是依赖项。 第一次设置云盒时，它会以固定版本的形式提取到 ~/.ccbeam/deps 中。 安装 ccbeam 不会为您未使用过的功能带来任何帮助。

将对话留在那里，然后再次拾起

由于该框仍然存在，因此您在其中进行的对话也会保留在那里。 关闭笔记本电脑并返回：

/ccbeam:up cloud resume      pick up a conversation living on the box

ccbeam cloud sessions        list them
ccbeam cloud resume          pick one up, starting a session here
ccbeam cloud rm <id>         delete one

简历是故意的一个单独的动词。 /ccbeam:up cloud 意味着此对话移至那里，并保留其会话 ID — 这就是其上下文得以幸存的全部原因。 /ccbeam:up 云简历采用不同的对话，并将您所在的对话保留在原来的位置。 如果他们共用一个动词，/ccbeam:up 可能会默默地放弃你的位置；他们不这样做，所以它不能。

会话选择器显示您第一次所说的内容、最后一次触摸文件夹的时间，并标记仍在运行的任何对话。 Ctrl-D 删除突出显示的文件，保留它所在的文件夹 - ccbeam 不会删除您的文件。 当盒子被唤醒时，30 天未受影响的对话将被删除，并且当这种情况发生时它会这样说。

断开连接后，盒子中的工作真正会继续，暂停的盒子会在飞行中冻结转弯并完整恢复。 不过，ccbeam 不会重新连接到旧终端 - 它不需要这样做。 成绩单就是会议，所以选择一个备份就是那边的 claude --resume，这就是每个光束已经做的事情。

ccbeam cloud destroy 摆脱了盒子。 ccbeam云修复构建了一个新的。

要求

您发送到的设备需要 ssh 访问权限、Claude Code（已登录）、节点 18+ 和 git。 ccbeam doctor <device> 告诉您缺少什么。 云盒会安装自己的云盒，但驱动它需要在您发送数据的机器上安装 Node 20.18.1+（而不是 21.x），因为 E2B SDK 在那里运行。 ssh 设备在 18 上运行良好。

$ ccbeam devices
  ● local                you are here
  ● gpu-box              2h ago
  ○ mac-mini             yesterday
  ⏸ cloud                paused

每个设备都使用 claude auth login 登录 Claude Code 本身。 这是故意的——见下文。

ccbeam 不会做什么

  • 永远转发凭证。 ccbeam 永远不会通过您的笔记本电脑代理模型调用或将您的令牌发送到其他设备。 Anthropic 的条款禁止在其他产品或服务中使用 Claude 订阅 OAuth 令牌；每个设备自我验证是唯一正确的设计，而不是工程师周围的限制。 云盒也不例外：它在自己的终端中自行登录，并且该登录仍然存在，因为暂停的沙箱保留了其文件系统。
  • 运行托管的任何东西。 不是中继，不是代理，不是默认 API 密钥，甚至不是在维护者帐户下发布的沙箱映像。 运行时路径中的任何内容都不依赖于您无法控制的基础设施。
  • 将您的 ssh 设备沙箱化。 Claude Code 与您一样在远端计算机上运行，​​并具有您的访问权限 — 就像您通过 ssh 登录并自己启动它一样。 云盒是隔离的，这是使用它的一个原因，但这是 E2B 的属性，而不是 ccbeam 的属性。
  • 团队访问控制。 这是您的设备和密钥。

它是如何运作的

  1. ccbeam 使用一个小的捆绑插件启动了真正的 claude，然后等待。
  2. /ccbeam:up 调用写入请求文件的工具。 斜杠命令无法接管终端，因此它不会尝试。
  3. 该插件的 Stop 钩子在回合边界处结束会话——在脚本完全写入之后。
  4. 一直拥有该终端的主管将记录和您的更改发送到目的地，并在那里启动附加到您的终端的真实克劳德。

远端没有任何协议可言，也没有守护进程； ssh 连接共享使每次重复调用保持在约 10 毫秒。

docs/design.md 介绍了管理程序为何必须存在，以及如何添加设备类型 — Fly Machines、Modal、Daytona 和普通 VM 都是 50 行 SshDevice 加上生命周期，这是贡献的预期形式。

发展

npm test          # unit tests — no network, no accounts
npm run test:e2e  # end-to-end, needs a reachable host in CCBEAM_HOST

单元套件通过本地的假设备驱动真正的播种和携带逻辑，因此捆绑→克隆→补丁是在没有主机的情况下进行的。 e2e 套件的设置位于 docs/design.md 中； TESTING.md 是机器无法自行检查的路径的手册简介。
